description: This Java class defines the RetrieveAclEntry command used to retrieve Access Control List (ACL) entries of a Thing by its ID and an authorization subject within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for constructing the command, parsing from JSON, and handling associated metadata, annotations, and deprecation notices.

classes.name: RetrieveAclEntry
classes.description: A final class representing a command to retrieve an ACL entry for a Thing, identified by its ID and an authorization subject, with support for JSON serialization/deserialization and schema validation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory methods for creating RetrieveAclEntry instances with different parameter types, including deprecated String-based versions.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a RetrieveAclEntry instance by parsing a JSON string or object.

methods.name: getAuthorizationSubject
methods.description: Returns the authorization subject associated with this command.

methods.name: getSelectedFields
methods.description: Returns an optional JsonFieldSelector indicating specific fields to retrieve.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Indicates the supported JSON schema version(s) for this command.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing this command targets.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Constructs the JSON pointer path to the ACL resource.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends command-specific payload data to a JSON object builder.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new RetrieveAclEntry with updated DittoHeaders.
